test_stimuli.name: ch0_mid_scale
test_stimuli.derivation: For ch0: stream bytes [0x00, 0x7F, 0xFF]; high_byte=0x7F, low_byte=0xFF; raw = ((0x7F & 0x03) << 8) | 0xFF = (0x03 << 8) | 0xFF = 0x3FF = 1023; half scale = 511. ch1 not read, default 0.

test_stimuli.name: ch1_zero
test_stimuli.derivation: For ch1: stream bytes [0x00, 0x00, 0x00]; high_byte=0x00, low_byte=0x00; raw = ((0x00 & 0x03) << 8) | 0x00 = 0. ch0 not read, default 0.

test_stimuli.name: ch0_full_scale
test_stimuli.derivation: For ch0: stream bytes [0x00, 0xFF, 0xFF]; high_byte=0xFF, low_byte=0xFF; raw = ((0xFF & 0x03) << 8) | 0xFF = (0x03 << 8) | 0xFF = 0x3FF = 1023.
